1.w: And he brought me out into the outer court, the way toward the north; and he brought me into the chamber that [was] opposite the separating courtyard, and that opposite the building toward the north.

2.w: Toward the face of [its] length [was] a hundred cubits, with the door [to] the north, and the width [was] fifty cubits.

3.w: Opposite the twenty [cubits] that [were] for the inner court, and opposite the pavement for the outer court, [was] a gallery to the face of a gallery in three parts.

4.w: And before the face of the chambers [was] a walkway, ten cubits wide and a [hundred] cubits long; and their doors [were] to the north.

5.w: And the upper chambers [were] shorter, for the galleries took away from them, on the lower and middle of the building.

6.w: For they [were] in three parts, and there was not unto them pillars like the pillars of the courts; upon thus it was shortened from the ground more than the lower and middle.

7.w: And a wall that [was] on the outside [was] over against the chambers, toward the outer court, toward the face of the chambers; its length [was] fifty cubits.

8.w: For the length of the chambers that [were] toward the outer court [was] fifty cubits, and, behold, upon those facing the temple [was] a hundred cubits.

9.w: And below these chambers [was] the entry on the east, as one enters them from the outer court.

10.w: Along the length of the wall of the court toward the south, toward the face of the separating courtyard, and toward the face of the building, [were] chambers

11.w: and a pathway before them, the appearance of the chambers that [were] toward the north, like their length so their width, and all their exits and according to their doors and according to their fashions,

12.w: and according to their doors of the chambers that [were] toward the south. A door [was] at the head of the walkway, directly at the face of the wall toward the east in entering them.

13.w: And he said to me: “The chambers to the north [and] the chambers to the south, which [are] toward the face of the separating courtyard, they [are] the holy chambers [in] which the priests, those who nearest to YHWH, will eat there the holy of holies; they will lay the holy of holies there—the grain offering, and the sin offering, and the guilt offering—for the place [is] holy.

14.w: With the entering of the priests, they will not go out the holy [area] into the outer court, and there they will leave their garments in which they minister—for they [are] holy—and they will put on other garments, they may come near to [that] which [is] for the people.”

15.w: And he had completed the measurements of the inner temple, and he brought me out through the gateway that [has] its face toward the east, and he measured it round about.

16.w: He measured the side to the east with a measuring rod, five hundred [cubits], by the measuring rod, all around.

17.w: He measured the side to the north, five hundred [cubits], by the measuring rod, all around.

18.w: The side to the south he measured, five hundred [cubits], by the measuring rod.

19.w: He came around to the side to the west; he measured five hundred [cubits], by the measuring rod.

20.w: At the four sides he measured it. A wall [was] unto it round about, a length of five hundred [cubits], and a width of five hundred, to separate between the holy [and] the common.
